# ADR-3027: A03: Eval of untrusted input for script lane 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Dynamic evaluation executes attacker payloads.

## Decision

Runtimes SHALL NOT perform eval of untrusted input for script lane 3 (A03-3).

## Consequences

Use parsers and allow-listed operations instead.
